text:
incidents-bot: PAGERS: GPU-POOL-EXHAUSTION firing on prod (severity=high). Queue depth > 30k across allocate-v2 pool. Autoscaler attempted scale but hit scale_cap. Paging oncall.

oncall-alice: I’m on it. seeing latency spikes on /v1/stream and 503s. linking dashboards: https://grafana/redwood/prod/gpu-pool

eng-sre-bob: confirmed. autoscaler logs show repeated FailedToAcquireShard errors and then RateLimitExceeded when requesting more nodes. guess: scale cap + leader lock contention.

runtime-lead-carol: also seeing continuous batching throughput drop — token/s spiking down. prefix cache hit rate collapsed to ~4% from 78% about 10:12 UTC.

oncall-alice: severity: customer-facing timeouts for long generation jobs, about 8% error rate on requests > 1024 tokens. big customers reporting degraded UX. support-erin, can you surface top-impacted accounts?

support-erin: pulling list now. top hit: acme-ads, beta-chat, and legal-ai. sending a DM to CSMs + status page note draft.

eng-sre-bob: stacktrace snippet from autoscaler:
```
ERROR autoscaler.Manager AcquirePool: scale request denied: exceeds_pool_quota
WARN autoscaler.LeaderLock: failed to become leader: timeout
```

runtime-lead-carol: config change earlier at 10:05 UTC rolled continuous-batching tweaks (increase batch_window_ms to 1200, enable aggressive prefix caching evictions). suspect regression.

ml-ops-frank: I rolled that change in A/B yesterday for throughput experiments. didn’t think it would affect prefixed KV cache. reverting candidate now.

oncall-alice: mitigation plan: 1) rollback continuous-batching change 2) temporarily lower batch_window_ms to 100 3) manually raise autoscaler cap for allocate-v2 if infra allows 4) enable fallback route to smaller-model-64B for long requests.

infra-lead-dan: I can bump scale cap from 120->180 GPUs in the pool but need approval from cost-control. doing emergency override window for 30min.

eng-sre-bob: while infra bumps, we should reduce inflight batch sizes to relieve KV pressure. runtime: give me the command to toggle.

runtime-lead-carol: toggle command:
```
curl -XPOST https://control-plane/api/v1/configs/continuous-batching -d '{"batch_window_ms":100, "enable_aggressive_eviction":false}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $OPS_TOKEN'
```

oncall-alice: executed rollback at 10:18 UTC. observed prefix cache hit rate climbing to 40% within 2 minutes. queue depth decreasing from 31k -> 18k.

eng-sre-bob: autoscaler cap increased; infra-lead-dan confirmed override at 10:20 UTC. new cap 180. scale requests now processed and new instances join.

support-erin: CSMs notified; status page update published: "High latency and errors affecting some customers; mitigation in progress."

ml-ops-frank: follow-up: that continuous-batching change had a bug in the eviction algorithm where small prefixes considered stale prematurely. reproducer attached to the rollout PR.

oncall-alice: immediate mitigation success indicators: 95th latency down from 5.2s -> 1.9s for streaming, errors down to 1.1%. still monitoring.

eng-sre-bob: creating incident task list: Pager handoff to dan at 10:30 UTC for infra actions, postmortem owner: carol, action owner for rollback + safe rollout: frank.

infra-lead-dan: leaving the emergency window open until pool stabilizes; will close at 10:50 unless new signs of saturation.

oncall-alice: thanks team. final checks: confirm fallback routing for long jobs is active? runtime-lead-carol: yes we have a traffic rule diverting 12% of >1024-token requests to model-compact for 20m.

support-erin: wrote customer-facing note to top affected accounts and added an update to the public status at 10:25 UTC.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigation applied, autoscaler cap raised, continuous-batching rollback performed. Monitoring will run for 30m. Incident channel will become #postmortem-2289990000 after closure.

oncall-alice: logging timeline and artifacts. if anyone has logs/metrics to attach, paste links here. postmortem meeting scheduled 2026-03-16 09:00 UTC. closing now from active page but keeping thread open for final notes.
